findings.text: The Component-1 envelope is additionalProperties:false over a closed 14-field required list, so the pre-envelope axes the C9-RIDE TO requires (stage_class, interim_status) CANNOT be carried inside a valid Observation_Record. Each artifact here is therefore a two-part object: an envelope-valid record plus a declared pre_envelope sidecar. This is reported, not worked around -- no schema was widened and no field invented. If the envelope is later meant to carry producer-side interim state, that is a field question for base as registry executor.

`plane` is one value per record, but an atom_layer0 run can span two: most read repo text (DESIRED) while Runs 25/26/33/35 additionally measured the live graph (APPLIED). These records declare plane DESIRED -- the plane the CERTIFICATE's scope is bounded to (repo-only) -- and the live-graph limb is visible in traversal_residue rather than silently folded into one plane. A multi-plane invocation may warrant either one record per plane or a declared primary-plane rule.

THE ENVELOPE CANNOT REPRESENT A DECOMPOSED SUBJECT. `population_predicate` is required as a non-empty string, but a DECOMPOSITION_FOUND run has NO population at its own grain -- S3 legislation is correctly not assessed, because the population belongs to the children (C3 and Territory, the sequence's two such runs). Both records are emitted ENVELOPE-INVALID on purpose and counted in the denominators: inventing a predicate string to pass the schema would be the exact fabrication the honest-populability audit forbids. The remedy is a field question for base -- either population_predicate becomes nullable with a declared absence semantic (the S6 0.1.1 pattern: null = POPULATION BELONGS TO THE CHILDREN), or decomposed subjects are declared out of the envelope's domain. 2 of 36 records affected; both named.

substantive_result here is computed by base's A5 rule rather than by the envelope's own governing sentence (PRD 2.1: any absent/failed status => UNKNOWN). Applied literally to stage_states, every production bundle would read UNKNOWN because s5 is NOT_ASSESSED by design. The A5 stage_class split is what makes the governing rule survive contact with this instrument, and both computations are printed so a reader can see they agree on the acquisition axes and differ only on the method stage.
